data.narrative:
Scale AI, a Series B AI & Software company, carries a current post-money valuation of $29.0B against $14.8B raised to date. The peer universe consists of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Palantir), spanning robotics, foundation models, and infrastructure plays at Series A through Series C stages. Top private peers include Figure AI ($39.0B), Reflection AI ($25.0B), and Skild AI ($14.0B).

Two valuation methods triangulate a defensible range. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implying $55.1B. Peer-Median analysis across 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields a $10.0B median, with a wide range of $3.2B to $39.0B reflecting stage and capability heterogeneity within the AI frontier-tech cohort. The peer median's substantial discount to current valuation reflects both the presence of earlier-stage companies in the set and potential valuation inflation in the current private market.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $8.5B (low) to $63.4B (high), with a median of $32.5B. The current $29.0B valuation sits within this band, marginally below the median. Key uncertainties include the reliability of peer comparables given rapid valuation volatility in frontier AI, the applicability of historical stage-progression multiples in a market dominated by generalist LLM competition, and the durability of Scale AI's data labeling moat relative to emerging synthetic training alternatives.
